description: Cost (costMyr) shows on the live output card but not in Semakan Lepas — persist costMyr into outputJson.image (like generatedMs) and show an RM chip in HistoryModal.

steps.name: diagnose (root cause)
steps.evidence: VisualPanel reads cost from GET /api/jobs (GenerationJob.costMyr). HistoryModal reads FeatureRun.outputJson which never stored costMyr (only kind/aspect/urlPath/prompt/scenes/generatedMs). Cost lives on the job + APIUsageLog, not in outputJson — so history has no cost to show.

steps.name: build
steps.evidence: visual-job computes costMyr before persist + writes into outputJson.image; HistoryImage += costMyr; HistoryModal shows RM chip next to time chip

evidence.stage1_spec_compliance: passed — costMyr now persisted to outputJson.image and shown in HistoryModal; matches live card
evidence.notes: cost computed before persist (reordered); graceful omission for pre-fix runs; no migration

steps.name: release-notes (CHANGELOG)
steps.evidence: CHANGELOG.md Fixed: cost missing in Semakan Lepas

steps.name: commit
steps.evidence: 9e0994e fix(studio): show generation cost in Semakan Lepas
